reviews.title: Terrible!
reviews.text: First, after test they gave me option to pay 1$ which was fine for me then it charged me 20$ automatically , i didn’t get anything in return. Was able to ask just 1 question and got unrelated primitive answer, so literally nothing and couldn’t continue conversation due to lack of credits? So what did i pay for? just to ask 1 basic question with no proper answer to that? I need my refund asap!
reviews.reply:
Dear [Name] , hello there!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review! We’re sorry to hear you had a bad experience. You can tell us more detail about the issue at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com (mailto:nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com). We'd like to make it up and change your mind! Have a beautiful day!
Best wishes, Nebula team

reviews.title: Gold diggers
reviews.text: So I took this Nebula quiz online and paid for the results then it requested me to download the app which I did, and it said it would automatically take me to my reading but there’s no reading at all? Besides, it asked me for my email as well to send the results but there’s not a single thing about it. Gonna delete the app immediately and never use it or the website again
reviews.reply:
Hello there, [Name]

Thanks a lot for your time, your feedback is crucial for our team.

We’re sorry to hear about your experience! 
After completing the quiz, your reading should have received it via email. It’s possible there was a technical issue, and we’d love to help resolve it.

Please reach out to our support team at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com, and we’ll make sure you receive your reading. We appreciate your feedback and would love the opportunity to improve your experience!

Warm regards, Nebula team 🔮

reviews.title: Charged me without my permission
reviews.text: Hello. Firstly they askes me 0.50 usd , and i paid . It was okay for me . Then they charged me around 50 euro ,without my permission. Please give me my money back
reviews.reply:
Dear Valued Customer,

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. 
We sincerely apologize for the confusion regarding the charges on your account.

We want to assure you that all additional purchases, including the €49.99 fee, were accurately described in the payment window during your trial registration. 
The details of the purchased services were sent to the email address you used during registration.

However, we understand your concerns and would like to resolve this issue as quickly as possible. Please contact our support team directly at support-appstore@asknebula.com regarding any unwanted or accidental payments, and our team will be happy to assist you with cancellation and refund options.

Your satisfaction is our priority, and we appreciate you bringing this matter to our attention as it helps us improve our service.

Warm regards,
The Nebula Support Team 💫️

reviews.title: Money fraud
reviews.text:
I am writing to formally complain about an unauthorized charge of $42.99 made by Nebula App.
I did not give my consent for this payment, nor did I approve any subscription renewal or purchase that would justify this charge. Charging a user without explicit authorization is unacceptable and violates basic consumer protection principles.
Though I applied vie e-mail regarding this issue couple times, I was ignored. Please be aware about this money fraud system
reviews.reply: Thank you for sharing your experience. We’re very sorry to hear about this and completely understand your frustration. Unauthorized charges are never intended, and we take these concerns very seriously. Please contact us immediately at support-appstore@asknebula.com, so we can review your account, investigate the charge, and work with you to resolve the issue promptly. Your trust and safety are extremely important to us, and we want to make this right. Warm regards, Nebula Team 🔮
